You could fall through the entire Earth in 38 minutes 🌍⏱️

The deepest hole humans have ever dug is 12 km. This tunnel would be 12,700 km, straight past a core about as hot as the surface of the Sun. And with nothing to catch you, you'd never stop falling.

Would you jump? Yes or no 👇

Thought experiment: an airless tunnel, ignoring heat and Earth's spin. Fall time: A. Klotz, American Journal of Physics (2015).

#physics #science #sciencefacts #earth #whatif

Whale earwax recorded World War Two 🐋👂

A whale's earwax never stops growing: a new layer every six months, like tree rings. Cut one open and scientists can read its whole life, from growing up to pollution and stress. Plugs from whales between 1870 and 2016 show stress spiking with whaling, and staying high through the war at sea.

What would your earwax say about you? 👇

Sources: Trumble et al., PNAS (2013); Trumble et al., Nature Communications (2018).

#whales #ocean #science #sciencefacts #history

This 2,300-year-old mummy has a golden tongue 👅✨

Egypt's "Golden Boy" was never unwrapped. A CT scan looked inside instead and found 49 amulets, 30 of them gold. A gold scarab sat over his heart to keep it silent on judgment day, and the golden tongue was there so he could speak in the afterlife.

What would you take with you? 👇

What if everyone on Earth woke up with $1,000,000? 💸

That's $8.3 quadrillion, a stack of $100 bills reaching the Moon 23 times. Prices would explode, and your million would buy what about $18,000 buys today. The twist: the poorest would still come out ahead, cash savers would lose, and billionaires would barely notice.

What would you buy first? 👇

You just deleted every debt on Earth. 🔴

All $365 trillion of it: mortgages, credit cards, everything. One catch: every debt is someone's savings, including your bank balance. Ancient Babylon actually did this, repeatedly.
